label: intended-r189-b1
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT /*+ BROADCAST(k) */ b.* FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.edge_queue_r189 VERSION AS OF 0 b JOIN
            (SELECT source_system,rel_type_id,id FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.schedule_r189_1 VERSION AS OF 0) k
            ON b.source_system=k.source_system AND b.rel_type_id=k.rel_type_id AND b.id=k.id) b FULL OUTER JOIN client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.schedule_r189_1 VERSION AS OF 0 s
            ON b.source_system=s.source_system AND b.rel_type_id=s.rel_type_id AND b.id=s.id
            WHERE b.id IS NULL OR s.id IS NULL OR instr(b.props_json,concat('"105":',s.old_json))=0
            OR NOT(s.old_json RLIKE '^"[0-9a-f]+"$') OR s.old_json=concat('"',get_json_object(s.props_json,'$.105'),'"')
            OR NOT(hex(encode(s.source_system,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.source_system,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(s.rel_type_id <=> b.rel_type_id) OR NOT(s.id <=> b.id) OR NOT(s.source_type <=> b.source_type) OR NOT(s.source_id <=> b.source_id) OR NOT(s.target_type <=> b.target_type) OR NOT(s.target_id <=> b.target_id) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.schema_revision,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.schema_revision,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(s.entity_version <=> b.entity_version+1) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.props_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(replace(b.props_json,concat('"105":',s.old_json),concat('"105":"',get_json_object(s.props_json,'$.105'),'"')),'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.retained_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.retained_json,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.order_key,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.order_key,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.source_feed,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.source_feed,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.source_epoch,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode('schedule-r189','UTF-8'))) OR NOT(s.source_position <=> b.source_position) OR NOT(s.published_at <=> s.published_at) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.lookup_hash,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.lookup_hash,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.apply_batch_id,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(decode(unhex('723138392d6231'),'UTF-8'),'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.source_cursor_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(concat('{"xid":"9007199254741101","seq":"',cast(s.id AS STRING),'"}'),'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.source_delivery_id,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(concat('r189-b1:edge:',cast(s.id AS STRING)),'UTF-8')))
